sentences.en: You can't accuse him of stealing unless you have proof.
sentences.zh: 除非你有证据，否则不能指控他偷东西。

sentences.en: Also cracks may form in buildings that aren't Earthquake proof.
sentences.zh: 此外，在非抗震建筑中也可能形成裂缝。

sentences.en: The answer is far more easily discovered than the proof.
sentences.zh: 这个问题的答案比证明更容易被发现。
